entries.incorrect: Answering only one part of a two-part question
entries.correct: Address all parts of the prompt
entries.strategy: Underline all parts of the question before planning

entries.incorrect: Ideas listed without explanation
entries.correct: Explain each idea with reason + example

entries.incorrect: Using a memorised essay regardless of question
entries.strategy: Practice with varied prompts; never memorise

entries.incorrect: Discussing a related but different topic
entries.strategy: Rewrite the question in own words before writing

entries.incorrect: This essay will discuss both sides.
entries.correct: While X has merits, this essay argues that Y is more significant because...
entries.strategy: Write a clear thesis statement in introduction

entries.incorrect: Task 1 with no clear overview paragraph
entries.strategy: Always include a clear overview sentence

entries.incorrect: Listing every data point in Task 1
entries.strategy: Select 3-4 key features; group by trend

entries.incorrect: Paragraph with no clear topic sentence
entries.correct: Begin each paragraph with a topic sentence

entries.incorrect: Moreover, furthermore, in addition, besides...
entries.correct: Use connectors only when adding genuine meaning
entries.strategy: Focus on logical progression, not connector density

entries.incorrect: The government... The government... The government...
entries.strategy: Practice pronoun, demonstrative, and synonym referencing

entries.incorrect: Changing every word from the prompt
entries.strategy: Paraphrase for clarity, not for change itself

entries.incorrect: Using obscure synonyms from thesaurus
Kids should not use phones all the time.
entries.correct: Children should not use phones excessively.

entries.incorrect: Repeating same word/idea multiple times
make a research
The develop of technology
The pollution is a serious problem.
depend of
The number of people are increasing
entries.correct: The number of people is increasing

entries.incorrect: The government announced new policies and tries to fix the problem.
entries.correct: The government announced new policies and tried to fix the problem.

entries.incorrect: Technology is good it helps us learn.
entries.correct: Technology is beneficial because it helps us learn.

entries.incorrect: The policy failed, it was poorly designed.
entries.correct: The policy failed because it was poorly designed.
entries.strategy: Punctuation rules; combine or separate clauses

entries.incorrect: enviroment
It might possibly perhaps be...
Essay ends without conclusion
entries.correct: Restate position and summarise main points
